svg.text: MECANIC — how the app works
producers → evidence ledger → consumers — the agent never sees raw adapter bytes (doc 14)
SOURCES — EVERY SOURCE SPEAKS THE SAME TYPED EVENTS
ELM327 DRIVER
real adapter: BLE · USB · TCP (ELM327-emulator)
AT init · chip fingerprint (clone detection)
tolerant parse — NO DATA = unsupported, not a crash
EMULATOR
scripted YAML vehicles — 15 labeled CI cases
speaking REAL ELM327 hex through the same driver
zero-hardware development + real wire protocol
CSV IMPORTER
VED · Torque · Car Scanner · wild forum logs
'bring your own log' — a WhatsApp'd CSV works
14,904 real trips soaked through it
CAN PRODUCER
frames → bus survey → DBC decode (opendbc, MIT)
counter/checksum classified before any decode
LISTEN-ONLY — no transmit API exists (doc 00)
EVIDENCE LEDGER
append-only JSONL · one schema · replay = a free regression test · the dossier IS the ingestion interface
session_start · complaint · history · vin · dtc · freeze_frame · mode06 · module_scan · pid_sample · window · flag
triage_finding · hypothesis_ranking · task · physical_test · measurement · verdict · fix_plan · verification · outcome
raw adapter bytes never cross this line — only typed events
ATTENTION FUNNEL — TOKEN EFFICIENCY WITHOUT DIAGNOSTIC LOSS
L0 · RAW
every sample is kept in the ledger
delta-compression is a token lens,
never a garbage bin
L1 · WINDOWS + RULES
windows derived from the data — never labels
idle · warm-up · rev-hold · cruise · load
14 deterministic rules — every flag carries
its values + message (provenance)
L2 · SLOT RESERVED
iForest + autoencoder
Phase 2 — zero-model
is the current canon
L3 · DIGEST
~1–1.5K tokens
the only thing the LLM
reads unprompted
L4 · LLM (OPTIONAL)
Nemotron 550B — the floor-test
drill-down tools: get_samples,
get_mode06 · replay_segment
offline → lexicon fallback
hybrid gate: windows require the engine running (a VED-soak lesson — 92 HEVs poison idle windows)
THE 9-STEP LOOP — THE APP IS THIS LOOP
stages 3–4 consume the funnel's flags
QUICK START — everything optional
one-line complaint: FR or Darija, any script, mixed in one sentence
chips + 'what was repaired recently?' — two paths, one ledger:
LLM extraction (optional) + offline lexicon — zero input still works
CONNECT + CAPABILITY CONTRACT
transport: TCP · serial · in-process emulator — chip fingerprint
subscription = the capability object (modes · actuation · poll rate)
Tier-C actuation cards hidden by construction on read-only adapters
AUTO-INTAKE — zero button presses (~30 s)
VIN · stored/pending/permanent codes · freeze frame
Mode $06 with factory limits · readiness + drive-cycle counters
module health map · ignition-off guard: 'key on', never 'dead bus'
FUNNEL + TRIAGE — findings read together with the hints
windows + rules → flags (L1, above) → triage findings
fault · drift toward limits · TAMPER forensics (Rapport Confiance engine)
paired statements ('votre sifflement colle avec +22% trims') · honest route-out
RANKING — the deterministic brain
13 playbooks activate on codes / flags / declared recent work
score = prior × chips × measurements × test results × comeback × history
confidence = strength × √share — every multiplier lands in the explainability trail
TASKS — two lanes, never blocking
AUTO — the agent alone
live watch · window mining
Mode $06 watch · re-rank on every event
report drafting — tech is away
NEEDS-YOU — queued cards (≤5)
spray · wiggle · swap · gauges · coding check
fuel-gated (no coil swap on a dCi) · NBA = ONE card
answers merge as events — any order, or never
6 · VERDICT
≥ 70 → VERDICT — cited
40–70 → ranking + NBA
< 40 → escalate, never guess
any state
FIX PLAN
parts priced in MAD (local table) · labor estimate · procedure
+ POST-REPAIR CONFIG STEPS: 'not repaired until it's coded'
injector C2i/C3i coding · adaptations · calibrations (doc 02 §3)
VERIFICATION — the fix must prove itself
consent-gated clear · the exact drive cycle for this model
Mode $06 recheck · 'did the fix hold' follow-up
the permanent DTC clears itself only when the car agrees
RECORD — the memory (per-VIN, hashed)
cross-visit trends: 'P0173 récurrent — vu sur 4 visites'
OUTCOME label — what actually fixed it (the flywheel tap)
monitors compared across visits → degradation before the MIL
DOSSIER — the pro artifact
French · evidence-cited · exportable at any moment — partial evidence =
partial dossier + 'what would sharpen this' (a sellable mid-state)
RAPPORT CONFIANCE — the buyer artifact (199–399 MAD)
+ the honesty box: 'ce que ce rapport NE peut pas vérifier'
derived from the ledger — never hand-written
[OBD] [INTAKE] [PHYSICAL] [MEASUREMENT] [PHOTO] [AGENT] — every claim cites its evidence
THE TECH'S EXPERIENCE — async by design (doc 12)
1 · plug in — zero taps (the complaint is optional)
2 · walk away — the AUTO lane keeps working
3 · phone buzzes: verdict ready, or ONE NBA card
4 · answer cards whenever — any order, or never
5 · return to a finished, evidence-cited dossier
≤ 30 s of human time per car — nothing ever blocks
CONFIDENCE BEHAVIOR (doc 02 §7)
≥ 70 → verdict: root cause + citations + runner-ups
40–70 → ranked differential + the ONE 2-minute card
< 40 → escalate — honest silence beats a guess
measured: tamper escalates at 22% · ignition-off refuses at 0%
PIPELINE GUARANTEES — measured, not promised
same code, different data → different verdicts (the P0171 pair)
healthy car → silence: 14,904-trip soak, 90.7% flag-free
zero false MAF flags on 6,151 real trips (LOAD-calibrated)
a real chronic fault found & diagnosed in public data (veh 249, +72%)
LLM optional everywhere — a dead model = lexicon fallback
~1.5K tokens/dossier offline · ~3.3K with LLM → 49–99 MAD economics hold
ENTRY POINTS — python -m mecanic …
run --scenario p0171_vacuum_leak.yaml — the full 9-step loop
benchmark — 15 labeled cases · verdict agreement 15/15
connect tcp://127.0.0.1:35000 | serial:COM3 — a live car
replay session.jsonl — a free regression test
outcome --session … — record what actually fixed it
confiance session.jsonl — the buyer report, from the ledger
soak VED/ [--diagnose 249] — fleet soak · real-car diagnosis
can frames.csv --dbc data/dbc/… — CAN survey + decode (listen-only)
104 tests · zero hard dependencies · works fully offline
40–70 → the ONE NBA card · answers merge → re-rank
THE FLYWHEEL — the moat (doc 00 step 9)
every closed session: outcome label (what actually fixed it) → playbooks + priors sharpen → the next car ranks better
outcome-verified patterns on the real parc — the data no competitor owns
the flywheel — every closed session sharpens the next diagnosis
15/15 benchmark · 104 tests · calibrated on 14,904 real VED trips · Nemotron floor-tested · listen-only everywhere
no guessing below 70 · every claim cites typed evidence · the LLM is optional by construction · replay = regression
